status: exploratory post-primary follow-up; specified before new enrichment results were inspected
question: Which independently curated mitochondrial pathways show enrichment in the archived signed Wald-statistic rankings?
pathways: All 149 MitoCarta3.0 GMX pathways, including hierarchy parents; no selection by study results. Overlapping sets are not independent discoveries.
mapping: Exact source-workbook Ensembl stable IDs. A MitoCarta record enters testing sets only if exactly one archived gene ID matches. All ambiguous or absent records are reported and excluded from set membership. No symbol or alias rescue.
ranking: All archived genes with finite stat and nonempty stable Ensembl ID. No mitochondrial-only background. Duplicate stable IDs are an error. Descending signed Wald stat, ties broken by stable ID for reproducibility; values are not jittered.
multiplicity: One joint BH family across every tested pathway in both contrasts. Ineligible pathways are reported with exclusions and no p-value. If any eligible test fails, stop without reporting a complete family.
reporting: Report all 149 pathways for each contrast, nominal p, joint-family BH q, ES, NES, log2err, matched size, curated size, leading edge and exclusion reason. Export coverage and warnings. Do not select only significant results.
robustness: Report rank ties, exact-ID coverage and pathway overlap; compare interpretation with existing primary fgsea and both CAMERA settings without replacing them. No extra methods or size thresholds in this first pass.
limits: Same study observations; not independent validation. No respiratory activity, protein abundance, protein conformation, or treatment-by-time inference. Three differentiation blocks and unresolved common-control timing remain limitations.
